title.ja: 図1-1 6六角からの金無双崩し
title.en: Figure 1-1: Breaking Gold Fortress from the 6六 bishop

explain.ja: 1つ目の手筋は、向かい飛車に構えて角が6六にいるときに使える手筋です。2枚の持ち歩と7七の桂馬もポイントです。これは基本の金無双崩しですが、手順が少し複雑なので頑張って覚えましょう。
explain.en: The first tesuji is usable with an Opposing Rook setup when the bishop is on 6六. The two pawns in hand and the knight on 7七 are also key. It is the basic way to break a Kinmusou (double gold), but the sequence is slightly complex, so work to remember it.

section.ja: 向かい飛車&6六角型での崩し方
section.en: How to break through Opposing Rook with the ▲6六角 setup

title.ja: 図1-2 端から手を付ける
title.en: Figure 1-2: Start from the edge

explain.ja: まず端の突き捨てから▲9三歩と打ちます。後手がこの9三の歩を取らないと、次に▲9五香と端を突破されます。ただし△9三桂とすると▲9四歩で桂馬が死ぬので、△9三銀か△9三香で歩を取りたいところです。端歩を捨てて▲9三歩と打ち込む手筋は、美濃囲いに対しても金無双に対しても有効です。
explain.en: First, push and sacrifice the edge pawn and drop ▲9三歩. If White does not take this pawn, ▲9五香 breaks through the edge next. But △9三桂 loses the knight to ▲9四歩, so White wants to take the pawn with △9三銀 or △9三香. The tesuji of sacrificing the edge pawn and dropping ▲9三歩 works against both Mino and Kinmusou. Next we look at the cases where White takes with silver and with lance.

section.ja: 向かい飛車&6六角型での崩し方
section.en: How to break through Opposing Rook with the ▲6六角 setup

title.ja: 図1-3 銀で取ってきた場合
title.en: Figure 1-3: If White captures with the silver

explain.ja: まず銀で取ってきた場合を考えます。次の手は知らないと指せないかもしれません。
explain.en: First consider the case where White captures with the silver. The next move may be hard to find unless you know it.

section.en: If captured with the silver

title.ja: 図1-4 角を切って銀をぶち込む
title.en: Figure 1-4: Sacrifice the bishop and ram in the silver

explain.ja: 角を切って△同香と取らせます。このとき△同桂なら、▲8四歩で桂馬が取れます。香車を吊り上げたら▲9二銀が狙いの一手で、次に▲8一銀、△同玉、▲8三飛成となれば金無双は崩壊します。角切りの後の▲9二銀が厳しい手です。
explain.en: Sacrifice the bishop and let White take with △同香. If White takes with △同桂 instead, ▲8四歩 wins the knight. After luring the lance up, ▲9二銀 is the key move, aiming for ▲8一銀 △同玉 ▲8三飛成, which collapses the Kinmusou. The ▲9二銀 after the bishop sacrifice is severe.

section.en: If captured with the silver

title.ja: 図1-5 後手は仕方なく角で受ける
title.en: Figure 1-5: White has to defend with the bishop

explain.ja: 後手はやむなく△8四角と受けますが、桂馬を跳ねて攻め駒を足します。せっかく取った角をこんなところに打つのはもったいないですが、後手にはこれが最善の受けです。
explain.en: White reluctantly defends with △8四角, but Black adds an attacker by jumping the knight. It is a pity to use the captured bishop in such a spot, but this is White's best defense.

section.en: If captured with the silver

title.ja: 図1-6 金無双を突破
title.en: Figure 1-6: Gold Fortress broken through

explain.ja: △9四香と香車が逃げたところで、▲8一銀と桂馬を取りに行きます。そこから▲9三桂成と桂馬を成り、じわじわ攻めれば優勢です。手順は、▲9五歩、△同歩、▲9三歩、△同銀、▲同角成、△同香、▲9二銀、△8四角、▲8五桂、△9四香、▲8一銀、△同玉、▲9三桂成です。
explain.en: After the lance runs with △9四香, go after the knight with ▲8一銀. Then promoting the knight with ▲9三桂成 and pressing gradually leaves Black better. The line is ▲9五歩 △同歩 ▲9三歩 △同銀 ▲同角成 △同香 ▲9二銀 △8四角 ▲8五桂 △9四香 ▲8一銀 △同玉 ▲9三桂成.

section.en: If captured with the silver

title.ja: 図1-4（再掲） 角を切って銀をぶち込む
title.en: Figure 1-4 (repeated): Sacrifice the bishop and ram in the silver

explain.ja: ▲9三歩に△同銀と取ってきた場合は、すぐに▲9三角成と角を切るのがポイントでした。その後は図1-4のように銀を打ち込み、▲8一銀を狙います。
explain.en: When White takes ▲9三歩 with △同銀, the key was to sacrifice the bishop at once with ▲9三角成. After that, drop the silver as in Diagram 1-4 and aim for ▲8一銀.

section.en: If captured with the silver

title.ja: 図1-7 香車で取ってきた場合
title.en: Figure 1-7: If White captures with the lance

explain.ja: ここで図1-2に戻り、▲9三歩に△同香と取ってきた場合を考えます。
explain.en: Now return to Diagram 1-2 and consider the case where White takes ▲9三歩 with △同香.

section.en: If captured with the lance

title.ja: 図1-8 香車を浮かせてさらに9三歩
title.en: Figure 1-8: Float the lance, then a pawn on 9三 as well

explain.ja: 桂馬で香車を狙い、浮いたところにさらに▲9三歩と打ちます。次の▲9二歩成は銀桂両取りになるので、後手は受けなければなりません。香車を吊り上げて裏側に歩を打つのです。
explain.en: Aim the knight at the lance, and drop ▲9三歩 again where it floats. The next ▲9二歩成 would fork silver and knight, so White must defend. You keep luring the lance up and dropping pawns behind it.

section.en: If captured with the lance

title.ja: 図1-9 相手の銀を動かす
title.en: Figure 1-9: Move the opponent's silver

explain.ja: 後手は△9一銀と受けますが、構わず▲9二歩成とします。△同銀と取った後手の銀がかなり狭くなっているのがわかるでしょうか。もし▲9二歩と打てれば、相手の銀が取れます。
explain.en: White defends with △9一銀, but Black plays ▲9二歩成 regardless. Notice how cramped White's silver becomes after taking with △同銀. If Black can drop ▲9二歩, the silver can be captured.

section.en: If captured with the lance

title.ja: 図1-10 銀が取れる
title.en: Figure 1-10: The silver can be captured

explain.ja: 端から無理やり歩を取って▲9三歩とすれば、後手の銀は助かりません。手順は、▲9五歩、△同歩、▲9三歩、△同香、▲8五桂、△9四香、▲9三歩、△9一銀、▲9二歩成、△同銀、▲9五香、△同香、▲9三歩です。
explain.en: By forcibly taking a pawn from the edge and playing ▲9三歩, White's silver cannot be saved. The line is ▲9五歩 △同歩 ▲9三歩 △同香 ▲8五桂 △9四香 ▲9三歩 △9一銀 ▲9二歩成 △同銀 ▲9五香 △同香 ▲9三歩.

section.en: If captured with the lance

title.ja: 図1-8（再掲）香車を浮かせてさらに9三歩
title.en: Figure 1-8 (repeated): Float the lance, then a pawn on 9三 as well

explain.ja: ▲9五歩、△同歩、▲9三歩に△同香と取ってきた場合は、▲8五桂から香車を狙います。さらに△9四香と浮いたところへ▲9三歩と打ち、そこから銀を取りに行くのがポイントでした。
explain.en: When White takes ▲9五歩 △同歩 ▲9三歩 with △同香, go after the lance with ▲8五桂. The key was then dropping ▲9三歩 where the lance floats on △9四香 and going after the silver.

section.en: If captured with the lance

title.ja: 図2-1 棒銀風の金無双崩しの基本図
title.en: Figure 2-1: Basic diagram of breaking Gold Fortress with Climbing Silver style

explain.ja: 2つ目の手筋は、棒銀風に金無双を崩す手筋です。使える条件は、図2-1のように向かい飛車に構えて銀が8五にいることです。
explain.en: The second tesuji breaks a Kinmusou in Climbing Silver style. It is usable when you have an Opposing Rook setup and the silver is on 8五, as in Diagram 2-1.

section.en: How to break Rushing Silver style

title.ja: 図2-1' 5五角が飛車取り当たる
title.en: Figure 2-1': The bishop on 5五 attacks the rook

explain.ja: 角を5五に打ったときに相手の駒(今回は飛車)に当たることもポイントです。この金無双崩しは、角交換した後に頻出する手筋です。
explain.en: Another key is that the bishop dropped on 5五 attacks an enemy piece (here the rook). This Kinmusou break frequently appears after a bishop exchange.

section.en: How to break Rushing Silver style

title.ja: 図2-2 角を打つ
title.en: Figure 2-2: Drop the bishop

explain.ja: まず歩を突き捨ててから角を打ち、飛車取りに当てます。この角打ちが後手の銀も睨んでいることに注目です。
explain.en: First push and sacrifice a pawn, then drop the bishop to attack the rook. Note that this bishop drop also eyes White's silver.

section.en: How to break Rushing Silver style

title.ja: 図2-3 角を切り、銀をとってしまう
title.en: Figure 2-3: Sacrifice the bishop and capture the silver

explain.ja: 後手が飛車を逃がしたところで、▲8二角成として金無双の守りの銀を剥がします。角を切る形で駒損ですが、これで棒銀が炸裂しそうです。
explain.en: When White moves the rook away, ▲8二角成 strips the defending silver of the Kinmusou. It sacrifices the bishop and loses material, but the Climbing Silver attack is about to explode.

section.en: How to break Rushing Silver style

title.ja: 図2-4 金無双を突破
title.en: Figure 2-4: Gold Fortress broken through

explain.ja: 角を切った後は、棒銀のように攻めていけば囲いは崩壊します。
explain.en: After the bishop sacrifice, attacking in Climbing Silver style collapses the castle.

section.en: How to break Rushing Silver style

title.ja: 図3-1 筋違いの角打ちから崩す
title.en: Figure 3-1: Break through with an off-file bishop drop

explain.ja: 次は筋違いの角打ちから崩す手筋です。角交換したときに使える手筋で、相振り飛車では頻出の角の使い方です。
explain.en: Next is a tesuji that breaks the castle by an off-line bishop drop. It is usable after a bishop exchange and is a common bishop use in Opposing Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 筋違いの角打ちから攻める
section.en: Attack with the suji-chigai bishop drop

title.ja: 図3-2 露骨な角打ち
title.en: Figure 3-2: An obvious bishop drop

explain.ja: 飛車と銀だけでは攻め駒が足りないので、▲5六角と打って駒の数を足します。狙いは露骨ですが、後手に適当な受けがなく、次の▲8四歩、△同歩、▲同銀からの攻めが分かっていても止められません。単純に8三に利きを足しているだけですが、後手には受ける手段がないのです。
explain.en: Rook and silver alone are not enough attackers, so add to the count by dropping ▲5六角. The aim is obvious, but White has no adequate defense and cannot stop the attack beginning ▲8四歩 △同歩 ▲同銀 even knowing it. It merely adds control to 8三, yet White has no way to meet it.

section.ja: 筋違いの角打ちから攻める
section.en: Attack with the suji-chigai bishop drop

title.ja: 図3-3 棒銀が決まる
title.en: Figure 3-3: Climbing Silver succeeds

explain.ja: 先手はここから▲8四歩、△同歩、▲同銀という攻めを狙います。図3-3では後手が△8三歩と受けても、駒の利きが1枚足りないため、そのまま▲8三銀成と攻められます。この手筋は角交換の相振り飛車でよく出ます。▲5六角打ちは相手が美濃でも金無双でも使え、無条件に角が打てればそれだけで優勢になります。
explain.en: Black aims for the attack ▲8四歩 △同歩 ▲同銀. In Diagram 3-3, even if White defends with △8三歩, White is one piece short in control, so ▲8三銀成 attacks anyway. This tesuji often appears in Opposing Ranging Rook with a bishop exchange. The ▲5六角 drop works against either Mino or Kinmusou, and if the bishop can be dropped unconditionally, that alone gives an advantage.

section.ja: 筋違いの角打ちから攻める
section.en: Attack with the suji-chigai bishop drop

title.ja: 図4-1 コビン攻めの基本図
title.en: Figure 4-1: Basic diagram of the kobin attack

explain.ja: 最後は玉のコビン(ある駒の斜め上のマス)を攻める手筋です。石田流に組んでいて歩を3枚以上持っているときに使えます。金無双崩しとして最も有名ですが、実戦で歩を3枚以上持てることは少ないので使う機会は多くないかもしれません。しかし金無双のコビンは大きな弱点なので、応用の効きやすい手筋です。
explain.en: Last is a tesuji attacking the king's kobin (the square diagonally above a piece). It is usable when you have built Ishida-style and hold three or more pawns. It is the most famous way to break a Kinmusou, though holding three pawns in a real game is rare, so chances to use it may be few. Still, the Kinmusou's kobin is a big weakness, so the tesuji is easy to adapt.

section.ja: 玉のコビン(=ウサギの耳)を攻める
section.en: Attack the king's kobin (the rabbit ear)

title.ja: 図4-2 継ぎ歩と垂れ歩
title.en: Figure 4-2: Tsugi-fu and tarefu

explain.ja: 継ぎ歩と垂れ歩で6四に攻めの拠点を作ります。6筋は金無双の弱点とされ、「ウサギの耳」と呼ばれています。
explain.en: Using the successive pawn and the dangling pawn (tare-fu), build an attacking foothold on 6四. The 6th file is considered the Kinmusou's weakness and is called the "rabbit ears."

section.ja: 玉のコビン(=ウサギの耳)を攻める
section.en: Attack the king's kobin (the rabbit ear)

title.ja: 図4-3 攻めが成功
title.en: Figure 4-3: The attack succeeds

explain.ja: 図4-2から後手の手番をパスしていますが、後手がどう応じても、次に▲6五銀と進出する手が受けられません。図4-3からは、次に▲6三銀と打ち込む手が非常に厳しいです。
explain.en: In Diagram 4-2, White's move is skipped, but however White responds, the advance ▲6五銀 cannot be stopped. From Diagram 4-3, the drop ▲6三銀 next is very severe.

section.ja: 玉のコビン(=ウサギの耳)を攻める
section.en: Attack the king's kobin (the rabbit ear)

title.ja: 図4-4 飛車も攻めに参加して好調
title.en: Figure 4-4: The rook joins the attack for a good position

explain.ja: 後手はやむなく△5四銀と受けますが、飛車を6筋に回って攻め駒を足せば、後手は受けきれません。6四に拠点の歩があるだけで、金無双は簡単に崩れます。
explain.en: White reluctantly defends with △5四銀, but if Black swings the rook to the 6th file and adds attackers, White cannot hold. With just a foothold pawn on 6四, a Kinmusou collapses easily.

section.ja: 玉のコビン(=ウサギの耳)を攻める
section.en: Attack the king's kobin (the rabbit ear)
